desc: Soft crash, 2 of 6: the next start's recovery screen (the launcher) asks "Paper Cut closed after you changed Texture filtering. Undo it?" inside it (one window: TTYD_UNDO_TEST presses Undo, settings.txt has it back), lists both crash-safe snapshots, and Continue from a few minutes ago (TTYD_RECOVERY_TEST=snap) loads the newest as file 1
log_must: ^\[undo\] offered: tex_filter 0 -> 1, \d+ s before it closed, 0 others
^\[recovery\] snapshot: crashsafe_G8ME01_2\.gci \(map gor_01, file 1, \d+ s before it closed\)
^\[recovery\] snapshot: crashsafe_G8ME01_1\.gci \(map gor_01, file 1, \d+ s before it closed\)
^\[recovery\] continue from a snapshot: crashsafe_G8ME01_2\.gci as file 1
